seo_title: Bull Marketing | Your Next $100K+ Month Is Hidden In Your Pipeline
seo_description: Run the numbers on your remodeling pipeline and find the revenue you're leaving on the table every month.
hero_sub: If you run a design-build or high-end remodeling firm, you're probably not losing money on ad spend — you're losing it in the gaps between lead, appointment, and close. Run your numbers and find it in under two minutes.
trio_title: The leak isn't your leads. It's what happens next.
trio_sub: Three quiet conversion gaps are where remodeling revenue actually disappears.
card1_body: Not every inquiry is a real buyer — but if your qualifying process is loose, good leads get treated like bad ones and quietly disappear.
card2_body: A five-point swing in show-up rate can be worth six figures a year on a $45K average project. It compounds fast.
card3_body: Most owners can't tell you their real close rate off the top of their head — which means they can't fix it either.
quote: "I thought my problem was lead volume. It wasn't — it was a 12-point gap in my close rate I couldn't see until I ran the numbers."
next_step_title: You've seen the leak. Now see what to fix first.
next_step_sub: Enter your details and we'll send the breakdown of exactly where your pipeline is losing money — and the highest-leverage fix for your business.
